mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce empagliflozin exposure, and combined use increases risk of euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (euDKA) with SGLT2 inhibitors.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely and watch for euDKA symptoms; consider alternative antiepileptic agent or increased empagliflozin dosing; counsel on euDKA warning signs.
